The FloPlast air admittance valve provides an essential component for sanitary pipework and drainage systems, allowing crucial airflow while preventing foul gases from entering a building. This reliable black air admittance valve removes the necessity of penetrating the outer roof shell for ventilation, simplifying plumbing installations in new builds or renovations. Tested and approved for a wide operational temperature range of -20°C to +60°C without requiring additional insulation, this FloPlast valve offers versatile installation options, including placement below the flood level of connected appliances. Recommended to not be used externally as environmental debris will affect the air tightness performance of the valve.
b: Can be Installed Below Flood Level
